title.zh: Gilead Sciences 企业智能体规模化三层运行模型（BRKSP620）
title.en: Gilead Sciences Three-Plane Enterprise Agent Scaling Operating Model (BRKSP620)

label.zh: 1. 安全厨房与立项归口层（Safe Kitchen Sandboxes & Idea Portal Intake）
label.en: 1. Safe Kitchen Sandboxes & Idea Portal Intake Plane

label.zh: 2. 立项期前置治理与风险分级层（Governance at Ideation & Risk-Proportional Triage）
label.en: 2. Governance at Ideation & Risk-Proportional Triage Plane

label.zh: 3. 可复用编排底座与分布式责任层（GENIE Orchestrator & Distributed Ownership）
label.en: 3. Reusable GENIE Foundation & Distributed Ownership Plane

label.zh: 隔离租户与合成数据沙盒

detail.zh: 提供创新安全厨房，阻断本机随意部署的影子原型接触受控数据
detail.en: Safe kitchen with synthetic data replacing risky localhost vibe-coded prototypes

label.zh: 前驻工程师与业务先锋网络

detail.zh: 源自 300 席试点的自发先锋深入 15+ 业务团队，现场测算基线工时收益
detail.en: Early champions from the 300-seat pilot embed across 15+ teams to baseline ROI

label.zh: WinWire 共建创意门户（Idea Portal）

detail.zh: 统一归口逾 10,000 个智能体与自动化诉求，利用相似度聚类消除重复造轮子
detail.en: Captures pain points across 10,000+ agents and clusters duplicate requests early

label.zh: SharePoint 红队测试与防泄漏规则

detail.zh: 严格剔除机密、个人身份与医疗健康隐私标签，受控试点 PubMed 与临床库连接器
detail.en: Blocks Secret, PII, and PHI labels while piloting PubMed & ClinicalTrials.gov

label.zh: 负责任 AI 委员会与架构预审模式

detail.zh: 安全、隐私、法务在立项期联席介入；命中企业架构认证模式即走快速通道
detail.en: Security, privacy, and legal align at ideation; approved patterns sail through

label.zh: 智能体辅助治理与实质人工把关

detail.zh: 用智能体加速评审与跨部门草稿预检（法务修订从 50 处降至 5 处），杜绝橡皮图章
detail.en: Speeds intake reviews and cuts legal redlines from 50 to 5 without rubber-stamping

label.zh: GENIE 企业主控编排器（Copilot Studio）

detail.zh: 基于 Teams 与 Work IQ 服务数千活跃员工，秒级检索政策地图并闭环数千张工单
detail.en: Serves thousands of active Teams users, resolving thousands of tickets rapidly

label.zh: 法务/药政专职子智能体分布式共建

detail.zh: 各业务线在主编排器下自主维护领域子智能体与技能，明确业务价值与责任主体
detail.en: IT, Legal, and Regulatory teams own sub-agents inside GENIE with clear accountability

label.zh: 全链路可观测性与采用率追踪平台

detail.zh: 精准定位真正具备执行权的智能体节点、前后工时差，并辅导 50% 采用率团队
detail.en: Tracks true workflow agency, cycle-time deltas, and coaches 50%-adoption cohorts

label.zh: 智能去重与投资回报初筛
继承权限与防泄漏边界
